Fixed a missing edge case in strip_prefix: it removed the first len(prefix) characters even when `name` did not actually start with `prefix`, instead of returning `name` unchanged.
Fixed the wrong return type in `count_words`: it returned `sorted(counts.items())` (a list of tuples) instead of the `counts` dict itself.
Fixed unique_ids to return the ordered list instead of converting it to a set, which lost ordering and the correct return type.
Fixed swapped arguments in `clamp_reading`: it called `clamp(low, reading, high)` instead of `clamp(reading, low, high)`.
Fixed swapped arguments in `setting`: it called `settings.get(default, key)` instead of `settings.get(key, default)`.
